summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K presenting its half-year 2026 results. The report details revenue of $3,097 million, operating profit of $448 million, EPS of 35.6 cents, and adjusted EPS of 47.7 cents. Management revised full-year revenue growth guidance down from ~6% to ~4%, while reaffirming trading profit, free cash flow, and ROIC guidance. A previously announced $500 million share buyback is underway with $216 million settled. No strategic transaction, M&A, or special situation event is disclosed; the filing is a routine earnings release.
